en: Insights: small samples are now shown (faded) instead of hidden, so Jev's data appears alongside people's
Insights: new version filter; by default only each game's current version is counted
Insights: the human series now counts only games played against Jev
More accurate statistics: moves made by the stand-in practice bot are no longer counted as Jev's, and an all-in call no longer counts as aggression
Jev's calibration in Hold'em is now checked on every decision, not only at showdown
zh: 数据洞察：样本较少的数据改为浅色显示而不是隐藏，Jev 的数据会和人类的一起出现
数据洞察：新增版本筛选，默认只统计各游戏的当前版本
数据洞察：“人类”系列现在只统计和 Jev 对战的对局
统计更准确：临时顶替的练习机器人的出招不再算作 Jev 的；德州里全下跟注不再算作激进动作
德州里 Jev 的校准度改为每次决策都核对，不再只在摊牌时核对
